# ARC NCGP Research Points Planner (13-Point System)

> Static client-side planning workbench for Australian researchers modelling multi-year grant pipelines under the Australian Research Council (ARC) National Competitive Grants Program (NCGP) 13-point system. Unofficial tool; rules verified November 2026.

## Structured Data

- [rules.json](/rules.json): Complete machine-readable definitions of all NCGP schemes, point weights, indicative launch windows, durations, funding bands, eligibility rules, legacy 0-point schemes, and official ARC URLs.

## Core ARC 13-Point Rules (Verified Nov 2026)

- **Hard Cap:** 13 Research Points per investigator across pending and active NCGP grants.
- **Point Lifecycle:**
  - **Pending (Submitted):** Points lock on the submission/closing date and remain locked until outcome announcement.
  - **Active (Funded):** Points remain locked continuously until the official project end date.
  - **Released:** Points return on the outcome date if unsuccessful, or after the project end date when completed.
  - **No Early Relinquishment:** Active projects and roles cannot be relinquished early to free up Research Points.
- **Legacy Grants (0 Points):** Existing Discovery/Linkage grants (DP, LP, DECRA, FT) consume 0 Research Points and can be plotted for workload visibility.
- **Teaching Relief:** Unsalaried Chief Investigators (CI, Lead CI, Node Lead CI, Lead CI/Director) are eligible for up to $50,000/year in teaching relief. Teaching relief cannot be combined with an SCI salary.
- **Eligibility Windows:**
  - **ECR Cutoff:** 5 years post-PhD conferral (adjusted for career interruptions) for Initiate Fellowships and SCI (ECR) roles.
  - **Indigenous Excellence:** Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander researchers up to 15 years post-PhD; the only scheme offering SCI (MCR).

## Scheme & Role Matrix

- **Explore** (Confirmed, Q1 2027 Mar, Annual, 3 yrs, $50k-$400k/yr): Lead CI (5), CI (3), SCI (ECR) (8).
- **Initiate Fellowships** (Indicative, Q2 2027, Annual, 3 yrs, Salary + up to $50k/yr): Lead CI (8).
- **Lead & Mentor** (Indicative, Q3 2027, Annual, 5 yrs, Up to $250k/yr + 2 postdocs + 2 HDRs): Lead CI/Director (7, no salary), SCI (ECR) (8).
- **Indigenous Excellence** (Indicative, Q4 2027, Annual, 5 yrs, $50k-$500k/yr): Lead CI (5), CI (3), SCI (ECR) (8), SCI (MCR) (8).
- **Collaborate** (Indicative, Q1 2028, Biennial, 5 yrs, $1m-$2m/yr): Lead CI/Director (7), Node Lead CI (5), CI (3), SCI (ECR) (8).
- **CIEF** (Indicative Sub-scheme, Q2 2028, Annual, 5 yrs, Co-funded infrastructure): Lead CI (4), CI (2).
- **Breakthrough** (Indicative, Q3 2028, Annual, 5 yrs, $200k-$600k/yr): Lead CI (5), CI (3), SCI (ECR) (8).
- **Prioritise** (Indicative, Q4 2028 EOI / Q2 2029 Full, Biennial, 7 yrs, $4m-$6m/yr): Lead CI/Director (7), Node Lead CI (5), CI (3), SCI (ECR) (8).
